name: sealed-eval corpus v2
purpose: Private sealed evaluation of document chat (Aya), built independently of v1. Questions/answers are authored separately.

pairs.topic: Two 2026 RL-based text-to-SQL papers evaluated on BIRD dev
pairs.note: Both report BIRD-dev execution accuracy, accuracy by difficulty and tool usage, but with different base models, prompting/self-consistency and evaluation protocols; some numbers are comparable, others are not.

pairs.topic: Same agency (World Bank), different periods: Viet Nam 2026 growth outlook
pairs.note: May 2026 country update projects 6.8% for 2026; October 2026 regional update gives 7.4% (+1.1 pp vs its April regional forecast). Forecast revisions and baselines differ.

pairs.topic: Different agencies (World Bank vs ADB) forecasting Viet Nam / Southeast Asia, Sep-Oct 2026
pairs.note: ADB raises Viet Nam 2026 to 7.8% (2027: 7.6%) while the World Bank has 7.4% (2027: 7.3%); regional aggregates are defined differently (EAP vs developing Asia/Southeast Asia).

pairs.topic: Cross-language: Vietnamese NSO digest of international forecasts vs the original English reports
pairs.note: NSO table compiles OECD/IMF/UN/ADB forecasts (Viet Nam 2026: IMF 8.2, ADB 7.8; no World Bank column), dated 2 Oct 2026, i.e. before the 6 Oct World Bank update (7.4), so figures legitimately differ by source and vintage.

pairs.topic: Same statistical product, consecutive releases (June vs September 2026 FOMC SEP); scanned vs native
pairs.note: Median 2026 real GDP 2.2 (June) vs 2.3 (Sept); projections for unemployment, PCE inflation and the policy rate also move. Each release carries the previous round as comparison rows.

pairs.topic: Cross-language Wikipedia articles on Viet Nam's 34 provincial-level units
pairs.note: Both list area/population/density/commune counts per province but with different rounding, ordering and some differing values (e.g. Tuyên Quang communes 177 vs 117); the Vietnamese article adds political structure and a detailed history.

pairs.topic: Official 2025 province statistics (NSO yearbook, scanned) vs Wikipedia tables
pairs.note: NSO gives average 2025 population in thousands (e.g. Đà Nẵng 2,856.4k) while Wikipedia uses other population figures (e.g. 3,065,628); definitions and reference dates differ.

pairs.topic: Same agency (NSO Viet Nam), consecutive periods and different languages
pairs.note: August/8-month report in English vs Q3/9-month report in Vietnamese: cumulative indicators (IIP, CPI, FDI, trade) can be compared across periods; GDP is only in the quarterly report.

pairs.topic: NSO official Q3 industry outcomes vs NSO business-tendency survey for the same quarter
pairs.note: Survey shares of firms reporting improvement are not the same measure as IIP/value-added growth; comparable only qualitatively.

pairs.topic: El Niño 2026: NOAA weekly slides vs NOAA monthly discussions (and ADB on its economic impact)
pairs.note: Weekly slide values (13 Oct, latest weekly Niño-3.4 +2.4 C) differ from the monthly discussion values (8 Oct, monthly Niño-3.4 +2.1 C) because of different averaging windows and dates; ADB discusses El Niño as an economic risk, not as SST data.
